column1: # scripts/size-budgets.tsv — frozen line-count budgets for every shipped
# SKILL.md and references/*.md (dogfoods this repo's own
# POLICY = FREEZE-RATCHET. Each budget below is the file's CURRENT `wc -l` at
# the moment this config was adopted — not an aspirational target. The gate
# (`scripts/ci-gates.sh size`) is GREEN today by construction. From here,
# budgets move in exactly one direction: DOWN, via consolidation of a file's
# content. Raising a budget to let a file grow defeats the point; if a file
# must legitimately grow, that is a decision to make explicitly (shrink a
# sibling, split the file, or consolidate duplication elsewhere), not a config
# FORMAT: one row per file, `<path relative to repo root>\t<max lines>`. Blank
# lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored. Every SKILL.md and
# references/*.md under .claude/skills/ must have exactly one row (fail
# closed: a file on disk with no row, or a row whose file no longer exists, is
# a gate failure — see scripts/ci-gates.sh cmd_size).
# Regenerate the CURRENT-size column (never hand-edit a budget upward) with:
#     -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | while IFS= read -r f; do \
